paragraphs.text: My eyes were fixed to the screen the entire duration of the film this was so brilliantly edited. The visuals were astounding — I absolutely loved the aesthetic of the film. The music was so perfectly done, and the story and actors were so perfect for each it just made for an incredible film.
I absolutely loved it. I especially loved the little films within the film, and just everything about this film.
It would be borderline criminal to give this film any less than 4/5. What a brilliant conclusion to my Marvel challenge!
